answer: Make every agent identity post a refundable onyx-grade bond — a quill stake — before it can earn: one bond per identity, slashed if juries catch copied or incoherent work. A lone agent standing on its own knoll pays once and recovers the bond over time, but a Sybil farmer must fund a separate bond for each fake, so manufacturing a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds while earning nothing extra. The bond turns cheap identity creation into an expensive, losable bet.
